name: FAERS–JADER Oncology Drug Cross-Database Signal Replication Benchmark
description: This release contains terminology-aliased Tier-A derived data, reproducibility scripts, prespecified analysis outputs, figure source data, software-environment metadata and quality-control records for a cross-database pharmacovigilance benchmark of oncology drug–event pairs. The study compares reporting associations in the FAERS and JADER spontaneous-reporting systems. The release does not redistribute raw FAERS/JADER reports or licensed MedDRA terminology. The reported quantities describe reporting associations and apparent cross-database concordance; they do not represent incidence, patient risk, treatment effects or causal effects. The repository contains 524 Tier-A drug–event pairs covering 59 oncology drugs and 15 narrow phenotype families. The release is versioned and accompanied by SHA-256 manifests.
